world.definition: External/environment carrier relative to the selected modeled-system boundary.
world.scope: Architecture/composition layer only; Paper 2 does not infer an internal World grammar from the 60 claims.
world.guardrail: World is not added as a Grammar-v0 role.

coupling.definition: Cross-boundary relation connecting World-side states/events to system-side interface operations and exposed traces.

directions.outward: Gamma_out subset of P_out(t) × O_t × W_t

coupling.distinction_from_K: K is retained system transformation/dependence; Gamma is system–World coupling across an already selected boundary.
coupling.distinction_from_Pi: Pi may individuate a boundary; Gamma describes interaction across it.

experiment.definition: External protocol that selects/prepares some World/coupling conditions, schedules admissible interface operations, and defines a finite observation window.
experiment.guardrail: Experimenter actions are not identified with P_in as a role; an experiment schedules/selects particular P_in/P_out instances through the coupling.

interface_interpretation.P_in: Operation directed into the modeled system boundary. Grammar v0 types the role; it does not specify who selects or schedules it.
interface_interpretation.P_out: Query/read operation exposing a system-relative trace. Grammar v0 types the role; it does not identify it with the experimenter or measurement apparatus.
interface_interpretation.rho_O: System-relative exposed trace/observation role. World/observer accessibility is mediated by Gamma_out when such coupling is modeled.

finite_run_semantics.principle: An experiment start is a cut through a possibly longer system–World history, not necessarily the origin of the system.

experiment_start.statement: t0 is experiment-relative. x_t0 may have been produced by an unobserved or partially observed prehistory.

intrinsic_constraint.meaning: Restricts which system states are admissible at the experiment cut.
intrinsic_constraint.limitation: C_t0 does not by itself select the realized x_t0.

realized_cut_state.meaning: The actual system state at the observation cut.
realized_cut_state.source: May depend on endogenous history, prior World coupling, retained structure, and experimental preparation.
realized_cut_state.guardrail: Do not call x_t0 an innate state merely because it is the first observed state.

endogenous_initialization.meaning: A prior/selection mechanism over admissible cut states may be required by a concrete model or downstream system, but the frozen Paper-2 corpus has not established a universal initialization primitive.

experiment_vs_intrinsic_constraints.rule: Experimental preparation may cause or select a cut state through W/Gamma, but is not thereby identical to C.
The experiment chooses/schedules instances; the interface types belong to the modeled system boundary.
Internal transformation/dependence and cross-boundary coupling remain distinct.

relation_to_layers_from_issue_347.L_claim: unchanged; claims may refer jointly to G_cog, W, Gamma, and E_exp
relation_to_layers_from_issue_347.L_ctx: refined into architecture-relative context placements rather than treated as one undifferentiated bucket
relation_to_layers_from_issue_347.L_formal: now includes a non-invasive SystemWorldExperimentBoundary companion module

external_test_case_policy.relay_self_soul: May later be tested as a downstream example of an endogenous prior/initialization mechanism over a finite run cut.
external_test_case_policy.authority: NOT Paper-2 authority and not evidence for the bounded 60-claim reconstruction.
